brief: Brent crude closed at $108/bbl, the highest since May, after continued Middle East hostilities. US Treasury yields bull-flattened (2yr 4.58%, 10yr 4.96%, 30yr 5.36%, all multi-year or multi-decade highs) and 2yr inflation expectations rose to 2.6%. Ahead of the midterms, Trump has proposed a $5,000 "Trump dividend" for every American adult if Republicans win both houses, spendable only in the US. Trump has also said gasoline will fall to $3 then below $2 once the US wins the war with Iran, and that the war will end immediately after the election. Rabobank counters that the IRGC has an incentive to prolong the conflict through the midterms, and WSJ reports Vance and Rubio see the war lasting through January 2029. Rising energy prices and inflation expectations have pushed OIS pricing to over 70% odds of a Fed hike at the September 16 FOMC meeting, though Bloomberg's survey shows 66 of 78 economists, including Rabobank, expect a hold. The ECB raised its deposit rate 25bp to 2.50%, which Rabobank calls its terminal rate through 2027 despite rising upside risk.

cards.claim: Brent crude oil closed at $108/bbl on Thursday, the highest price since May, after rising almost 7% on the day.
cards.anchor: climbing almost 7% on the day and closing at $108/bbl, the highest price since May

cards.claim: The 2-year US Treasury yield reached its highest level since July 2024 at 4.58%.
cards.anchor: the 2-year marking its highest level since July 2024 at 4.58%

cards.claim: The 10-year US Treasury yield rose to 4.96%, the highest level since October 2023.
cards.anchor: the 10-year making its way up to 4.96%—the highest level since October 2023

cards.claim: US 30-year Treasury yields jumped 7.3bp to 5.36%, the highest level since 2002.
cards.anchor: US 30-year Treasury yields jumped 7.3bp to 5.36%, the highest level since 2002

cards.claim: 2-year inflation expectations soared to 2.6%, the highest level since June and more than 0.71 percentage points above the July lows.
cards.anchor: 2-year inflation expectations soared to 2.6%, their highest level since June

cards.claim: The Trump administration is promising a $5,000 Trump dividend to every American adult, contingent on Republicans winning control of both houses of Congress in the midterms.
cards.anchor: the promise of a $5,000 “Trump dividend” issued to every American adult if, and only if, Republicans win both houses

cards.claim: Trump said the $5,000 dividend could only be spent in America, naming Canada, China, and Germany as excluded destinations.
cards.anchor: we don’t want you going to Canada to spend the money. We don’t want you going to China, to Germany.

cards.claim: Trump said gasoline prices will fall to three dollars a gallon and ultimately below two dollars a gallon once the US wins the war with Iran.
cards.anchor: Three Dollars a gallon, but ultimately, below Two Dollars a gallon.

cards.claim: Trump told reporters the war with Iran will end immediately after the election because Iran cannot hold out any longer.
cards.anchor: the war is going to end immediately after the election because [Iran] can’t hold out any longer.

cards.claim: The Wall Street Journal reported that VP Vance and Secretary of State Rubio estimate the war with Iran could last through January 2029.
cards.anchor: VP Vance and Secretary of State Rubio estimate that the war could last through January 2029

cards.claim: Rabobank argues the IRGC has an incentive to escalate the conflict going into the US midterms and drag out the war for as long as possible.
cards.anchor: the IRGC has an incentive to escalate going into the midterms and drag out the conflict for as long as possible

cards.claim: The US OIS curve implies investors are pricing in more than a 70% chance of a 17.7bp hike at the September 16 FOMC rate decision.
cards.anchor: investors are pricing in more than a 70% chance of a hike (17.7bp) at the September 16 FOMC rate decision

cards.claim: 66 of 78 economists surveyed by Bloomberg forecast the Fed will hold rates at the September meeting, a view Rabobank shares, against market pricing that leans toward a hike.
cards.anchor: economists surveyed by Bloomberg see things differently, with 66 out of 78 analysts forecasting a hold

cards.claim: US headline PPI rose 0.4% m/m and 5.4% y/y in August, up from 4.7% y/y in July, in line with expectations.
cards.anchor: the August headline measure rising 0.4% m/m and 5.4% y/y, up from 4.7% y/y in July

cards.claim: Headline CPI is expected to rise 0.4% m/m and 3.4% y/y in August, a hot monthly print but a stable annual rate.
cards.anchor: Headline CPI is expected to rise 0.4% m/m and 3.4% y/y in August

cards.claim: The ECB raised its deposit facility rate by 25bp to 2.50%.
cards.anchor: the ECB announced its decision to raise the deposit facility rate by 25bp to 2.50%

cards.claim: ECB President Lagarde called the rate hike decision a no-brainer.
cards.anchor: ECB President Lagarde referring to the decision as a “no-brainer

cards.claim: Rabobank's Bas van Geffen argues the ECB is now at the top end of the neutral range and urges caution regarding future policy hikes.
cards.anchor: the ECB is now at the top end of the neutral range, and any next policy decision will be a trade-off

cards.claim: OIS curve pricing implies investors are positioned for more than four additional ECB hikes by July 2027.
cards.anchor: OIS curve pricing implies investors are positioned for more than four ECB hikes by July 2027

cards.claim: Rabobank forecasts 2.50% as the ECB terminal rate, with no additional hikes or cuts through the end of 2027, though it says upside risks to that view have increased.
cards.anchor: Rabobank sees 2.50% as the terminal rate and does not forecast any additional hikes or cuts through the end of 2027

cards.claim: Bloomberg reported that Canadian PM Mark Carney and Ukrainian President Zelenskyy signed a declaration of a 100-year partnership at a joint press conference.
cards.anchor: Carney and Zelenskyy spoke at a joint press conference yesterday, during which both parties signed a “declaration of a 100-year partnership

cards.claim: Canada pledged to boost its drone production capacity as part of increased industrial cooperation with Ukraine.
cards.anchor: and Canada pledged to boost its drone production capacity

cards.claim: Japan's August PPI is expected to cool to 0.0% m/m from 0.1% but accelerate to 7.4% y/y from 7.2%, which would be the hottest y/y reading since March 2023.
cards.anchor: expected to cool from 0.1% m/m to 0.0% m/m but pick up in the y/y measure from 7.2% to 7.4%
